title: Color
slide_intent: Show how to reproduce a color family as it becomes lighter or darker. Specifying each step gives designers in different media a common reference.
strategic_value: CSAIL can support variety in charts and backgrounds while retaining a traceable relationship to its seven base hues.
demonstration: Each hue occupies a column. Two darker rows precede a taller base-color row, with three lighter rows beneath. Cells carry hex values.
practical_value: Look up a screen value by column and row. For a printed piece, use the guide’s Pantone reference and a physical chip when the match is uncertain.

content_islands.name: Medium guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the screen and print reproduction notes at left and include the tint and shade guidance beneath.

content_islands.name: Color matrix
content_islands.spec: Align seven contiguous columns. Start with dark shades, enlarge the base swatches, then step through the lighter tints. Label each cell on its own background.

content_islands.name: Tool note
content_islands.spec: Place a small note low in the left column explaining how to obtain variants.
